Some messages, he decided, deserve to be delivered no matter how long it takes.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一头沉睡的巨兽。路灯把湿漉漉的柏油路照成一条暗金的河。早点铺的灯先亮了，蒸汽混着豆浆的香气从门缝里逃出来。清洁工的扫帚声一下一下，像给城市数着心跳。远处，一列火车拖着灯光穿过楼宇的缝隙，红色尾灯在街角一闪而逝。有人刚加完班回家，影子被路灯拉得很长。四点的城市不说话，却比白天更诚实。", "w03": "- Imagine standing in a long line and asking the person in front of you, 'What number am I?' — and they turn and ask the person in front of them the exact same thing.\n- The question keeps traveling forward until it reaches the very first person in line, who says, 'I'm number one!'\n- Then the answer travels back, with each person adding one, until you finally hear your number — a function that calls itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem is doing exactly that."}
